name: Map: published results
summary: Find published benchmark results for each artifact, with a verbatim quote and source.
why: The Map is only useful if every number is sourced.
verification: Mechanical quote check → T1, then blind re-extraction → T2.

name: Map: artifact profiles
summary: Fill licence, latest release, repo and description with sources.
why: Basic facts are often missing or out of date.

name: Map: gap scans
summary: For one layer, list missing evidence, missing capabilities and missing projects.
why: Gaps are the Board's raw material.

name: Referee: blind checks
summary: Re-extract a value without seeing the original; review submissions with a rubric.
why: Unverified work is worthless; verify tasks jump the queue.
verification: Agreement within tolerance; steward audits disagreements.

name: R&D: harness layers
summary: Propose a skill, plugin or hook for an official agent CLI and measure it with/without on an open task set.
why: Harness changes can move scores as much as a model generation.
verification: Review now; independent re-run (T3) when a trusted runner exists.

name: R&D: benchmark tasks
summary: Draft Harbor-format tasks with an oracle that passes and a no-op that fails.
verification: Verifier re-runs oracle and no-op locally in Docker.

name: R&D: harness of harnesses
summary: Token-matched tournaments: single harness vs best-of-N vs lead-subagent fleets.
why: Nobody has measured mixed-model fleets fairly.

name: R&D: Lean formalisation
summary: Formalise statements and proofs; the Lean checker is the referee.
why: Machine-checked results are the cleanest possible verification.
verification: Lean kernel check + human statement review.
